pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions during localized liquidity pullbacks or falling knife dynamics; pyramiding is authorized only after a minimum of +$8.00 open profit and confirmed structural continuation.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a validated ATR-based volatility buffer (minimum 1.5x 14-period ATR) away from apparent swing highs/lows before initializing stop-loss placement.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing activation immediately at +$5.00 and enforce hard scaling to let winners run between $15.00 and $30.00.
